items.title: Rogers Park Family Killed In Fire Remembered For The Love They Gave
items.description: The four family members, including a Kilmer International Academy eighth grader, died Thursday morning. Loved ones remembered their kindness, close family bonds and the impacts they made on others.

items.title: Two Scooter Riders Killed In Separate Chicago Crashes, Including One Involving Police
items.description: The Chicago Police Department is investigating both incidents. The fatalities have renewed conversations about safety for bike and scooter riders in the city.

items.title: IBM Unveils Company’s First Quantum Computer In Illinois At Hyde Park Labs
items.description: Gov. JB Pritzker joined company officials in unveiling the Quantum System Two, which will move into a national center for algorithm and application development at a South Chicago quantum computing campus once it opens.

items.title: Gilbert Villegas Faces Challenger In 36th Ward Race — For Now
items.description: Villegas is backing a challenge to the petition signatures of potential candidate Luis Gomez, Jr., a city worker who's launched a bid for 36th Ward alderman.

items.title: Can The Illinois THC Drink Ban Be Stopped? Hemp Industry Advocates Sue To Try
items.description: A hemp trade group is seeking to halt a state law that would take hemp-derived THC products off the shelves of non-dispensary businesses on Nov. 12.

items.title: Fat Peach Bakery Opens 2nd Location In Hyde Park
items.description: With a soft opening this weekend and a grand opening planned for next week, the popular Bridgeport bakery is bringing its scratch-made pastries to 53rd Street.

items.title: 7 Candidates Running In Coveted Race For 25th Ward Alderman
items.description: Aida Flores, Nubia Batista Willman, Ian Watkins, Miguel Chacon, Leonardo Quintero and Chula C. Ortiz are vying to unseat incumbent Pilsen Ald. Byron Sigcho Lopez. Two are facing challenges to their petition signatures.

items.title: 2 Logan Square Residents To Challenge Ald. Anthony Quezada In 35th Ward Race
items.description: Quezada, appointed last year by the mayor, faces businessman Daniel Tobón and affordable housing project manager Omari Bektemba in the 2027 election.
